<thought>To propose a single-step retrosynthesis, I need a template that represents the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction: it breaks an alcohol and a newly formed C‑C bond, and forms a carbonyl (C=O) and an alkene (C=C). I will search the template catalog for such a transformation applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alcohol"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["carbonyl", "alkene"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O", "C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
